scenario.dead_are_not_seen: dead people are neither seen nor counted
scenario.decision: fixed priority: eat if hungry and holding; claim if hungry at the source; wait if hungry at an empty source; yield if hungry, not emergency, off the source, source in view, crowd >= yield_at and stock < crowd; walk to the source if hungry; else walk home; with several sources of a kind, head for the nearest (steps, then id) seen with free stock, or the nearest if none in view has stock; a claim or draw takes from that source, recorded as the decision's target
scenario.food_allocation: kernel sorted full tick-start roster (including inactive actors), rotated by tick mod actor_count; personal scores confer no priority
scenario.movement: one step per tick along the longer axis (x on ties), four neighbours, co-location allowed
scenario.name: grid-world
scenario.perception: self always; others in radius: identity, position, free food (not hunger, home, or decision); source position is a known landmark; source stock only when the source cell is in view (absent otherwise, never stale); with several sources, every source position is a known landmark and seen_stock records the free stock of each source in view
scenario.scoring_crossover: GO > YIELD iff hunger >= hungry_at + seen_crowd - yield_at + 1 (both eligible)
scenario.scoring_order: lexicographic (tier, pressure), greatest first; eligibility unchanged
scenario.scoring_scale: one hunger point and one observed person each add 2 pressure units; equal weighting is a modelling assumption, not an empirical scale
scenario.scoring_ties: GO odd, YIELD even: never equal; CLAIM/WAIT and HOME/REST mutually exclusive; no additional tie policy
